run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a dataset using a model, data loader, and DatasetEvaluator
test_inference_on_dataset: test the inference_on_dataset function with a simple model and custom evaluator
create_result_cache: create a ResultCache to save and load evaluation results to a directory

review_DatasetEvaluators_has_finished_pr: review the DatasetEvaluators wrapper to check if all evaluators have finished processing
